scope: The reproduced late issue reader denial after another declared owner-list reader started. Original and candidate each execute one revision SELECT in this denial case; candidate includes one additional issue_list home key.
additionalSafeKey: issue_list at the already resolved authenticated owner home

upstreamPgParameterText.method: Previously measured with installed pg 8.23.1 prepareValue; one comma plus quoted issue_list (10 bytes), one comma plus quoted UUID (36 bytes). Two existing parameter containers and SQL text are unchanged.

possibleReturnedRow.framingFormula: 1 message code + 4 length + 2 field count + 3 * 4 field lengths

projection: The extra key is not included in the successful sibling reader response. A denied issue reader keeps its original failure result.

closedPlanBound.claim: The one-extra-issue-key bound is specific to this reproduced late-issue case. Other partial failures can leave up to three safe planned keys unused.

limitations: These are PG parameter value and DataRow frame bytes, not a bound on TLS/TCP framing, complete transport egress, CPU or total bytes of arbitrary failures.
A revision SELECT failure can leave more readers without best-effort revision metadata in this request; it never fabricates proof and the next request reads fresh.
The real PG regression is authored in the existing mandatory suite but was not executed locally.
